card.name: Punctuation in philosophy paper citations
card.fires_on: Punctuation right after the year or page numbers in academic bibliography entries, mostly PhilPapers-style philosophy listings. It fires on the closing parenthesis after an author's year, and on periods, colons or brackets in the citation.

modes.label: After author year
modes.description: The closing parenthesis after a year in parentheses following an author name in a philosophy reference list.

modes.label: Journal volume and page punctuation
modes.description: Periods, colons or brackets after volume, issue or page details in a journal citation.
